This is the library source from the published `block` 0.1.6 crate. The local patch declares the Blocks runtime’s `_NSConcreteStackBlock` storage as a pointer array and uses its address for the block’s `isa` field. The declarations also make the existing C calling convention explicit. The patch keeps the Objective-C Blocks layout while avoiding Rust’s uninhabited static diagnostic. The standalone upstream test harness is excluded from this dependency copy.
